brokerage_accounts_reported_total_check.name: brokerage_accounts_reported_total_check
brokerage_accounts_reported_total_check.value: (reported_total IS NULL) = (reported_total_currency IS NULL) AND (NOT holdings_unreported OR reported_total IS NOT NULL)

tax_warnings_subject_check.name: tax_warnings_subject_check
tax_warnings_subject_check.value:
CASE WHEN type = 'assumed_year_config' THEN tax_year IS NOT NULL
               ELSE security_id IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL END

transactions_split_needs_ratio.name: transactions_split_needs_ratio
transactions_split_needs_ratio.value: kind <> 'split' OR split_ratio IS NOT NULL

transactions_dividend_needs_class.name: transactions_dividend_needs_class
transactions_dividend_needs_class.value: kind <> 'dividend' OR dividend_class IS NOT NULL

transactions_needs_security.name: transactions_needs_security
transactions_needs_security.value: kind = 'fee' OR security_id IS NOT NULL

user_profiles_marginal_rate_check.name: user_profiles_marginal_rate_check
user_profiles_marginal_rate_check.value: marginal_rate IS NULL OR (marginal_rate >= 0 AND marginal_rate < 1)
